prompt.project_info: A top-down secret-garden editorial centered on white blossoms, ivory fabric, and leaf-filtered golden light.
prompt.main_subject: An adult brunette woman with medium loose waves, natural warm-toned makeup, and a calm eyes-closed expression. She lies comfortably on grass among white wild roses, wearing an ivory silk chiffon midi dress with a modest square neckline, short flutter sleeves, and opaque lining.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical top-down close portrait: flowers and foliage frame face and upper body; one arm rests gently above her head. Keep the pose relaxed and non-sexual, the garden natural, and all imagery free of logos or readable text.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Golden-hour sunlight filtering through leaves at 3900K creates soft dappled shadows, creamy highlights, natural skin texture, flower detail, and muted film-like warmth.
prompt.technical_specs: Canon EOS R5 with an 85mm lens at f/1.8, vertical 3:4 crop, face in focus, soft floral bokeh, visible fine grain, gentle natural vignette.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: High-fashion editorial portrait of an adult brunette woman lying comfortably on grass in a hidden garden among white wild roses and lush green leaves. Her medium loose waves spread naturally among the flowers, eyes closed with a calm expression. She wears an ivory silk chiffon midi dress with a modest square neckline, short flutter sleeves, and opaque lining. Vertical top-down close portrait, one arm resting gently above her head, golden-hour sunlight filtering through leaves and creating soft dappled shadows, natural skin texture, creamy floral bokeh, warm film-like softness, no text or logos.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sheer clothing, lingerie, sexualized pose, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, logo, readable text, extra fingers, distorted anatomy
